purpose: Map raw recipe ingredient lines to stable Garnish ingredientId values without duplicating ingredient identity.

recommendedFields.ingredientStateHint: raw | cooked | dry | fresh | canned | frozen | liquid | paste | powder | unknown

qualityRules: matchedIngredientId must exist in Ingredient Dictionary when matchStatus is matched.
High ambiguity terms must not be resolved with confidence above 0.92 unless context disambiguates them.
Dish names such as قورمه سبزی or آش رشته must not be treated as ingredient IDs unless the ingredient line explicitly refers to an ingredient mix.
Do not import Nutrition Source Layer records as ingredient records.
